resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts calls the 1938 cab ground-mounted; firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say it sat on a log crib. The story reports both views and does not choose between them.
The 2007 report names the Salmon-Challis National Forest; the other sources say Challis National Forest. The sources do not say which name is current.
A 1937 newspaper item shows the lookout being built that August; the other sources date the completed cab to 1938. Both are kept in the record.

notes_for_editor: The brief's kind is still unknown. Idaho Fire Lookouts says ground-mounted; firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say log crib, so the editor may set kind to ground once mounting is settled. firelookout.com says early 1970s and Idaho Fire Lookouts says 1970s, with no exact year, so no staffed_last event was entered. No source describes remains or current conditions. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page has a 'Hike-In' label that the story reports, and the wilderness access level is inferred from the wilderness designation, not from a source that addresses visitor access.
